Fix evidence (2026-11-19 PST), operator key change:
- Operator Mac (env 492a5c71) now signs with its own authorship key, SHA256:va7mtsoMZ4fqriZ7lEH1dhnzwNJ+q9zbOBuWSKiuvUs (public-key comment rebar-mac-492a5c71). It was added to identity 594c-9dcf-5ad6-4e6d by the KEY_ADD in tracker commit 9c70c2a2854 (2026-11-19 09:47:11 PST); `ssh-keygen -lf` on that KEY_ADD's public key gives the same fingerprint.
- Review bot's tickets clone (env ad49f17f) keeps its key, fingerprint prefix oGCqzgfDMp. The two environments now sign with different keys. Date of the change: 2026-11-19 PST.
- Enforced check: `rebar verify-identity --require-authenticated --base 9c70c2a2854~1` on the tracker reported 2 verified events: the KEY_ADD and comment fa102c6da62 (2026-11-19 09:48:21 PST), which was signed with the new key. The other 3 events in that range are MCP-server writes (env eea68b7f) that report bad-signature; that is the separate open bug starving-sphalerite-skua, not this ticket.
- No repository file changes: this was an operator key change on the Mac.
